title: Kohlberg Mertens Structure Theorem
body_html:
Kohlberg Mertens Structure Theorem

For finite games with fixed player and action sets, let $\overline E$ and $\overline G$ denote the compactified equilibrium graph and game space. The projection $$ \pi:\overline E\to\overline G $$ is homotopic to a homeomorphism.

MFoGT uses this structural theorem to derive robustness and genericity facts for Nash equilibrium components.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 5, Thm. 5.3.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Projection from the compactified equilibrium graph is homotopic to a homeomorphism.
